entities.summary: Stade Barthélemy Boganda, in Bangui, is the national stadium of the Central African Republic. It is located at Avenue de France and was used mostly for football matches. The stadium has a maximum capacity of 35,000. It is named after the former president of the country, Barthélemy Boganda. The venue is home to several popular clubs in the country including AS Tempête Mocaf.
